children: HashPort, Japan's leading non-custodial wallet, officially integrates Kaia. Its more than one million users can now hold and send Kaia-based JPYC and USDT in a single screen, placing the network's stablecoins inside a widely used Japanese self-custody app.

The integration gives Kaia real distribution among Japanese retail users at scale. JPYC and USDT on Kaia become usable for everyday transfers without separate custody arrangements, which supports the network's stablecoin settlement push and its payments expansion in Japan.

Access is limited to the Kaia-based versions of the two stablecoins, so balances on other chains are not covered. Wider wallet reach is nonetheless a tangible step for on-chain stablecoin activity, and future usage through HashPort will show how the integration converts into volume.
